title: Project：CLI 数据管理器 Milestone 3

project.title: 现代 C++ CLI 数据管理器
project.portfolioOutcome: 一个具备多文件模型、持久工作区、CMake/CTest、相对写入基准与失败复盘的现代 C++ CLI 项目。

objectives: 把持续演进的多文件 Project 组织成可复现、可测量、可复盘的 CMake/CTest 目标图。
victoryConditions: clean configure、cli-data-manager target、CTest、CLI 集成输入、相对写入基准和 Portfolio 检查全部通过。

starterFiles.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cpp_learn_cli LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_library(record_model record.cpp store.cpp)
target_include_directories(record_model PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_executable(cli-data-manager main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cli-data-manager PRIVATE record_model)
enable_testing()
add_executable(record_store_tests tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(record_store_tests PRIVATE record_model)
target_compile_definitions(record_store_tests PRIVATE PORTFOLIO_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PORTFOLIO.md")
add_test(NAME record-store COMMAND record_store_tests --todo)
